name: Ferry
author: Ferry
description: Share one keyboard and mouse between your machines. Shows where your pointer is, and opens the controls to pair, arrange and tune.

barWidget.description: Where your keyboard and mouse are, at a glance: this machine, or another one you reached across the screen edge. Click for peers, lock and the way into Arrange and Pair.

schema.label: Show the peer's name
schema.description: Write the other machine's name next to the icon while your input is on it, or it is controlling this one. Off keeps the name in the tooltip.
